summary.taskName: Design and execute QA test cases for Cancelling Leave Requests

test_plan.objective: Verify the cancellation workflow for PENDING and APPROVED-future leave requests, the disabled cancel state for REJECTED/past-APPROVED, and accurate balance restoration messaging.

in_scope: Cancel button enabled for PENDING requests
Cancel button disabled (span) for REJECTED and past-APPROVED requests
Keep Request button dismisses without cancelling
out_of_scope: Backend balance ledger verification (covered by API tests)

entry_criteria: Employee with at least one PENDING leave request exists
risks: Test data dependency: a PENDING request must exist before cancel tests run

test_cases.title: Cancel button is enabled for PENDING request
preconditions: At least one PENDING leave request exists
steps: Wait for Recent Leave Requests table
Assert Cancel button is a <button> (aria-label='Cancel Request') for PENDING row
test_cases.expected_result: Cancel button is an enabled <button> for PENDING rows.

test_cases.title: Cancel button disabled for REJECTED request
preconditions: At least one REJECTED leave request exists
steps: Assert Cancel action is a <span> (not a <button>)
test_cases.expected_result: Cancel action for REJECTED rows is a <span>, not a clickable button.

test_cases.title: Cancel confirmation modal renders correctly
steps: Click Cancel on first PENDING row
Assert confirmation dialog contains 'Cancel Leave Request' heading
Assert 'Yes, Cancel Request' button is visible
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation modal appears with correct text and both action buttons.

test_cases.title: Keep Request button dismisses modal without cancelling
steps: Click Cancel on first PENDING row
Assert modal closes and request still shows as PENDING
test_cases.expected_result: Modal closes; request status remains PENDING.

test_cases.title: Successfully cancel a PENDING leave request
steps: Click Cancel on first PENDING row
Click 'Yes, Cancel Request' in confirmation modal
test_cases.expected_result: Success state shown with 'Request Cancelled Successfully' and balance restoration note.
